_note: Weights and thresholds of the GOAT ENGINE. The owner asked for best judgement, so these are the engine's own settings, unchanged since the first version. The engine reads them at every run.

transit._note: A double transit means Jupiter and Saturn both hit a target sign, by conjunction or by their full aspects, in the same sampled instant. The targets are the house, its lord and the karaka, all counted from the Lagna.

dasha._note: Owner decision. The antardasha lord need not be relevant. A window counts when the mahadasha or the pratyantardasha lord is relevant. Relevant planets are the house lord, occupants in the Lagna chart and in the rotated D9, the karaka, and planets that aspect the house by natal aspect.

rule._note: For ordinal, count and type questions the promise net is turned into a strength between minus 1 and plus 1 by dividing by this scale and clamping. A strength of minus 1 is the lowest option and plus 1 the highest.

quality._note: Life area quality. Severity points are the malefic points of the promise plus marker_weight for each affliction marker, as a percent of the full weight sum. Below mild_percent the outcome is positive. From severe_percent, with an active affliction dasha after the event, the outcome is separated. From very_severe_percent with an active affliction dasha, the outcome is severe, such as divorce. Otherwise challenged. These thresholds are provisional and the owner can set them.
